name: Attribute discount entries

For the AAMP product (PBE list 3150) with attribute key {Remote Automation Agent, On Premise, Non-Production} matching ABA row 12DWC00000JupTR2AZ (AdjustmentType=Override, AdjustmentValue=1575), expect NetUnitPrice = 1575 (list x 0.5), NetTotalPrice = 1575 x Qty.

notes: Branch traced and verified live. The two H-06 steps (V21 step 9 'Attribute-Based Price' parent ListContainer35; step 10 'Attribute Discount Entries' parent ListContainer38) are unconditional ListGroups (no advancedCondition) -> they run on every line as a decision-table Get against Attribute_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table; a matching attribute hash applies the Override/adjustment to NetUnitPrice (output NetUnitPrice + Subtotal=ItemNetTotalPrice), a non-match passes through. This is DISTINCT from the D-category 'Attribute Value Pricing' matrix path which gates on Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true AND Attribute_Price_Mode__c in {Calculated,Unit Price,Total Price}; the H-06 line correctly has Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=false / Attribute_Price_Mode__c=null, confirming it is the ABA-discount path, not the matrix path. Preflight all green: PBE active+book active+USD+list 3150 non-zero; line non-renewal (Quote_Type__c=New), Deal_Type__c=Fortra Originated (no partner/COLA confound), Perpetual; 3 attributes all IsPriceImpacting and matching the ABA condition hash; Source_List_Price__c seeded (1575) so no headless base-seed-gap risk (the H-01/H-02/D-03 Apex-line $0 artifact does NOT apply here -- this line was UI-attributed and carries a seeded base). This is the positive control that proves the attribute-discount mechanism applies a discount to NetUnitPrice; it is the working sibling of D-03's missing-config gap (D-03 FAILED because {SFTP,OnPrem,Non-Production} has no ABA row, an ORG-CONFIG gap; H-06 tests that the MECHANISM works when a row DOES match, which it does). Sibling SFTP lines on the same quote net 0 (no Source_List_Price__c seed) but that is the unrelated D-03 config/seed finding, not an H-06 concern. defect_provenance=none/catalog-derived; no defect.
verdict_reason: Live V21 Force-reprice of a real UI-attributed AAMP line {RAA,OnPrem,Non-Production} matched Attribute Based Adjustment Override 1575 via the attribute decision-table get and stamped NetUnitPrice=1575 (=list 3150 x 0.5) with NetTotal=1575xQty, on the unconditional Attribute Discount Entries / Attribute-Based Price steps with valid inputs -- exactly the expected attribute discount applied to NetUnitPrice.
